routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_v2_product(p_product_code text, p_section text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles student
    join public.v2_purchases purchase on purchase.student_id = student.id
    join public.v2_product_grants entitlement on entitlement.purchase_id = purchase.id
    join public.v2_products product on product.code = entitlement.product_code
    where student.id = auth.uid() and student.role = 'student' and student.is_active = true
      and product.code = p_product_code
      and (p_section is null or p_section = any(product.sections))
      and public.v2_access_window_contains(purchase.confirmed_at, purchase.expires_at,
        purchase.revoked_at, statement_timestamp())
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_v2_access()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'product_code', access.code, 'sections', access.sections, 'expires_at', access.expires_at
  ) order by access.code), '[]'::jsonb)
  from (
    select product.code, product.sections, max(purchase.expires_at) as expires_at
    from public.profiles student
    join public.v2_purchases purchase on purchase.student_id = student.id
    join public.v2_product_grants entitlement on entitlement.purchase_id = purchase.id
    join public.v2_products product on product.code = entitlement.product_code
    where student.id = auth.uid() and student.role = 'student' and student.is_active = true
      and public.v2_access_window_contains(purchase.confirmed_at, purchase.expires_at,
        purchase.revoked_at, statement_timestamp())
    group by product.code, product.sections
  ) access;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_v2_batch_schedules()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'batchId',b.id,'batchRevision',r.batch_revision,'revision',r.revision,'state','published',
    'productCode',b.product_code,'title',r.document->'title','sections',r.document->'sections',
    'timeZone',r.document->'timeZone','liveRegistrationLimit',r.document->'liveRegistrationLimit',
    'events',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'key',ev.value->'key','title',ev.value->'title','section',ev.value->'section','kind',ev.value->'kind',
      'startsAt',ev.value->'startsAt','endsAt',ev.value->'endsAt','instructor',ev.value->'instructor'
    ) order by ev.ordinality) from jsonb_array_elements(r.document->'events') with ordinality ev(value,ordinality)),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) || case when r.document ? 'sessions' then jsonb_build_object('sessions',
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',s.value->'key','title',s.value->'title','section',s.value->'section') order by s.n)
      from jsonb_array_elements(r.document->'sessions') with ordinality s(value,n)),'[]'::jsonb)) else '{}'::jsonb end
    order by b.id),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.v2_batch_enrollments e join public.v2_course_batches b on b.id=e.batch_id
  join lateral (select batch_revision,revision,document from public.v2_batch_publication_revisions
    where batch_id=b.id order by revision desc limit 1) r on true
  where e.student_id=auth.uid() and e.active and r.document->>'state'='published'
    and public.can_access_v2_product(public.v2_entitlement_product_code(b.product_code));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_portal_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
                        SELECT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
                                WHERE id = auth.uid() AND role = 'admin' AND is_active = true
                                  );
                                  $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_v2_template_drafts()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.is_portal_admin() then raise exception 'Active Admin access required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  return (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'productCode', t.product_code,
    'revision', r.revision, 'document', r.document) order by r.created_at desc, t.id), '[]'::jsonb)
    from public.v2_course_templates t join public.v2_course_template_revisions r
      on r.template_id = t.id and r.revision = t.latest_revision);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_v2_price_rewrite()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception 'Append a new price version; existing prices are immutable' using errcode = '22023';
end;
$function$

routines.signature: v2_access_window_contains(timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)
routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v2_access_window_contains(p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_revoked_at timestamp with time zone, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce(isfinite(p_start) and isfinite(p_end) and p_revoked_at is null
    and p_start <= p_at and p_at < p_end, false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v2_entitlement_product_code(p_course text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select entitlement_product_code from public.v2_course_offerings where code=p_course;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v2_student_has_product(p_student uuid, p_product text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles s
    join public.v2_purchases p on p.student_id=s.id
    join public.v2_product_grants g on g.purchase_id=p.id
    where s.id=p_student and s.role='student' and s.is_active
      and g.product_code=public.v2_entitlement_product_code(p_product)
      and public.v2_access_window_contains(p.confirmed_at,p.expires_at,p.revoked_at,statement_timestamp())
  );
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER v2_price_history_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.v2_price_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_v2_price_rewrite()
